svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: graph-canvas architecture: dynamic hybrid Canvas 2D / React DOM rendering
svg.desc: Six panels. 1: why neither pure DOM nor pure Canvas scales. 2: the four paint layers inside one container (EdgeCanvasLayer, SVG drag preview, NodeLayer, NodeCanvasLayer, plus chrome and accessibility). 3: how a node is promoted from canvas pixels to a React DOM element and demoted again, and the invariant that the DOM layer equals selectedNodeIds. 4: ports declared as data through getNodePorts, the three glyph shapes and the outward-normal anchor maths that positions edge ends on them. 5: hit testing through three rbush R-trees, one each for nodes, ports and edges. 6: the per-instance Zustand store, the interaction hooks that write to it, the layers that read from it, and the cross-graph GraphLink.
svg.text: Canvas 2D paints the crowd. Any node you touch becomes a real React DOM element. One isolated store keeps the two populations exact.
